name: 📱 Mobile (Android + iOS / Compose + SwiftUI / hiệu năng, chất lượng, UI/UX)
name_en: 📱 Mobile (Android + iOS / Compose + SwiftUI / performance, quality, UI/UX)
description: Cấu hình chuẩn cho ứng dụng di động Android và iOS trong MỘT profile: Solo-Dev workflow, chống spam thao tác (Debounce/Loading), Jetpack Compose stability/recomposition, Gradle nhiều module + build-logic, R8 keep rules, baseline profile, SAF/content URI, Hilt, Room migration, analytics không PII, chống ANR/Bitmap-PDF OOM, cờ PendingIntent an toàn, mã native NDK; iOS: Swift 6, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency (@MainActor), chống retain cycle, XCTest; luật chung (Clean Architecture, TDD paired oracle); ngân sách hiệu năng đo được, kỷ luật chất lượng và UI/UX (Material 3 + Apple HIG, a11y, dark mode, Zero-Slop).
description_en: Android and iOS mobile apps in ONE profile: solo-dev workflow, anti-spam debounce/loading, Jetpack Compose stability/recomposition, multi-module Gradle + build-logic, R8 keep rules, baseline profiles, SAF/content URIs, Hilt, Room migrations, PII-free analytics, ANR and bitmap/PDF OOM prevention, safe PendingIntent flags, NDK native code; iOS: Swift 6, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency (@MainActor), retain-cycle prevention, XCTest; shared rules (Clean Architecture, TDD paired oracle); measurable performance budgets, quality discipline and UI/UX (Material 3 + Apple HIG, accessibility, dark mode, Zero-Slop).
